- No changes were made to code or logic—documentation update only.

- No changes to workflow, capabilities, format, or baseline knowledge.
- Facilitates faster comparative analysis and up-to-date context for new research in the field.

- Added a note encouraging users to star the project's GitHub repository at the end of SKILL.md.
- No changes to logic, functionality, or workflow—documentation only.

Initial release of 3dgs-paper-reader.

- Reads and summarizes 3D Gaussian Splatting research papers from arXiv or local PDFs.
- Extracts and structures key information including method, core innovations, experiments, results, and limitations.
- Outputs publication-quality summaries with comparison tables.
- Supports both English and Chinese prompt triggers.
- Integrates baseline knowledge of major 3DGS-related methods for contextual comparison.
